text:
beta_ops: Hey - we started getting embedding dim surprises and timeouts this morning around 06:42 UTC. Our pipeline expects 1536 but getting 768 from some calls and some 502 spikes. All traffic nominally from us-west-2. Example curl we use:
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-1536","input":"testing"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```
beta_ops: Response (headers): x-region: eu-west-1, x-runtime: embeddings-v3, x-request-id: rwd-req-bf1a9d3. Body shows "dimension":768. We're shredding indexes downstream. No code changes.

carmen_support: Sorry about this. Can you paste the full x-request-id and the org id? Also do you have an example request body+response body saved?

beta_ops: Request id rwd-req-bf1a9d3, org: beta-fintech-prod. Snippet: {"data": [ { "embedding": [ ...768 values... ], "dimension": 768 } ] }

carmen_support: Thanks. I'm checking routing logs for that request. Do you always call the global api.redwood.ai host or use a regional endpoint?

beta_ops: Global host. Our infra sits in us-west-2. Historically we see us-west serving. This started at 06:42. We detect by size checks and drop bad dims currently but want faster detection.

nate_runtime: Looking at rwd-req-bf1a9d3 trace - it's routed to eu-west-1 due to temporary capacity pressure in us-west-2. eu-west-1 is running a memory-optimized embedding variant that emits 768-dim vectors for the model alias text-embed-1536 (quantized reduction). We recently deployed a mapping change that should not allow mismatched dims but a rollback left a tolerant fallback enabled. That's why it served 768 instead of rejecting.

sylvia_sre: Also seeing ~900ms cold-starts in eu-west-1 at 06:41-06:45 due to a scale-down from a nightly batch in us-west-2 that finished and freed GPUs, causing autoscaler churn. The combination = higher p95s (~2.1s) and some 502/503s while pods spun.

beta_ops: We had an alert when indexers saw 768 dims. We disabled some consumers. We need a reproducible check and a mitigation without a code deploy.

carmen_support: Immediate mitigations: (1) We can pin your org to us-west-2 in the control plane for 24-72h; (2) We can make global host reject cross-region fallbacks that change dimension (will return 409) while you patch; (3) You can add a local guard to validate dimension from response and short-circuit. Which do you prefer?

beta_ops: Pinning at platform level is best. We can't push a DNS change quickly. Please do that. Also can SRE add a healthcheck we can call to verify region mapping?

nate_runtime: I enabled org-region pinning for beta-fintech-prod -> us-west-2. Also toggled the strict-mapping flag so incompatible variants return 409 for now. We'll monitor errors to avoid mass failures.

deploy_bot: deploy-bot: Started rollout runtime/strict-embed-mapping@v2026-03-16T06:55:10 1% canary in eu-west-1

sylvia_sre: Increased reserved capacity in us-west-2 by 1 GPU to reduce spillover while we watch traffic patterns for 30m.

beta_ops: Thanks. Do you have a short script to check which region served a given request? We want to add it to CI to detect regressions.

carmen_support: Quick snippet: 
```python
import requests
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings', json={'model':'text-embed-1536','input':'ci-check'}, headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+KEY})
region = resp.headers.get('x-region')
dim = resp.json()['data'][0]['dimension']
print(region, dim)
if dim != 1536:
    raise Exception(f'Unexpected dim {dim} from {region}')
```

beta_ops: We'll add that. Any ETA on fixing the mapping bug so eu-west doesn't have the reduced-dim variant mapped to the same alias?

nate_runtime: Root cause: alias mapping table had a stale entry after last-week's canary rollback. I pushed a fix to remove the incompatible mapping and added a configuration test. Patch ID RW-ENG-emb-577. Expect all regions to either serve correct 1536 or reject with 409 within 10 minutes.

deploy_bot: deploy-bot: Completed rollout runtime/strict-embed-mapping@v2026-03-16T06:55:10 - success

sylvia_sre: Early telemetry: we saw a small bump in 409s (calls that would have received 768) and a drop to zero for 768-dim responses after the patch. US-west routing metrics show backpressure easing. Latency p50 now ~340ms, p95 ~610ms.

beta_ops: Confirmed from our side 1536 restored and no 768 samples in last 5m. Thanks. Please keep pin for 24h.

carmen_support: Will keep pinning and we'll notify you when it's relaxed. Follow-ups: (1) We'll add a public doc about fallback behavior and model-alias mapping caveats; (2) Runtime will add a response header x-served-variant-id so clients can assert variant; (3) SRE to add a synthetic job that calls all regions once per hour and validates dims.

nate_runtime: Filed RW-ENG-emb-577 (fix) and RW-ENG-emb-578 (synthetic region-dim-check). Also adding metric embedding.variant.mismatch.fallback and alert if >0.01% of requests for alias.

beta_ops: Any chance of compensation for the index reprocessing we had to do? Billing we've already sent a ticket.

carmen_support: I opened a billing case and CC'd your org. We'll evaluate reprocessing credits once we have impact numbers.

sylvia_sre: Action items: monitor for 24h, keep org pin, watch 409 counts, and verify autoscaler policies to avoid same window of churn. I'll follow up on autoscaler tuning.

beta_ops: Appreciate the quick coordination. Leaving thread open to monitor. :thumbsup:

carmen_support: Thanks all. We'll update once the 24h window completes. :white_check_mark:
